text_block_list.text:
After getting permission from the local fisheries association
that Hishi Akebono is good friends with, we arrived at... that deserted island.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, feels amazing out here!
It's the perfect day for harvesting kelp!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Still... Trainer, that's a whole lot of luggage!
What in the world did you bring all that for?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Tons of water, a fire striker...
Oh, you even have an edible wild plant guide!
choice_data_list: Well, after getting stranded last time...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Oh yeah, that did happen, didn't it?
You collapsed right around here, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You really gave me a fright back then~
I didn't know what I was gonna do if you didn't open your eyes!
choice_data_list: You looked like a goddess to me back then.
You looked like a goddess to me back then.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you're totally exaggerating~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Do you think goddesses are big like me too, though?
If I meet anyone who knows, I'll have to ask them next time~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
For now, set that luggage down and... let's get started!
Time to gather lots and lots of yummy kelp~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They said we can catch seafood too!
Trainer, keep watch so the birds don't steal anything, okay?

After seeing Hishi Akebono off to gather kelp and seafood,
I spent two hours watching our gear in the shade—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Traineeer! Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I caught some huge shellfish and fish~!
I'm gonna whip up lunch with all of this right now~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I brought an earthenware pot today~
It's definitely gonna turn out super yummy~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you just kick back and relax, Trainer!
You must be tired, right? Keeping watch takes a lot out of you~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just give me a little bit~
Once you eat this, you'll be full of energy!

Hishi Akebono skillfully sets to work prepping everything.
It looks like there isn't much I can help with here.
Still, it feels wrong to just sit around zoning out.

Since I brought a wild plant guide anyway,
I decide to look around for some ingredients myself.
...I search around for a while, but can't find anything that fits the bill.

I spot some mushrooms, but even with a guidebook, an amateur shouldn't take chances.
Disappointing as it is, I should probably give up here.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Traineeer! Traineeer!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Found you! Whew, thank goodness~
What happened? Did you get lost?
choice_data_list: No, I was just looking for ingredients...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, are you super-duper hungry by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I didn't just make hot pot, you know!
I've got skewers, and I'm grilling stuff up too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It'll be ready in a jiffy,
so just hang tight for a tiny bit longer~!

A spread fit for a sumo stable appears before my eyes.
Skewered fish, grilled vegetables... and even rice to finish off the hot pot.

Every single dish tastes incredible, and despite the monumental portion,
my chopsticks never slow down—I clean every last plate.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Did that hit the spot?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Seeing you enjoy it so much makes me so happy~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you always eat with such a big smile on your face,
and that brings me so much joy~

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so glad you became my Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you're hungry, just say the word~
I'll whip up tons and tons of food for you again!

Hishi Akebono beams with sheer satisfaction. She seems happy enough
just serving food, but I still want to give something back in return.
I make up my mind to find a chance to treat her to a meal next time.
